caseName: Passiatore v. Merit Sys. Prot. Bd.
caseNameFull: Lawrence W. PASSIATORE v. MERIT SYSTEMS PROTECTION BOARD.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 26, 2015, within which *295to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
